title: pip hash checking switched off
description: pip.conf declares a `require-hashes=false` installer setting. A verification or locking control is switched off, so the integrity guarantees the ecosystem offers are not applied here. This rule reads a `require-hashes=false` installer setting.
remediation: Turn the control back on and fix what it reported instead of disabling the check. Specifically: fix a `require-hashes=false` installer setting.
limitation: It matches a `require-hashes=false` installer setting in the parsed pip.conf; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
